description: API to register events with a gapless sequence, chained hash and qualified timestamp, and to request signed certifications anyone can verify.
rules: Use a test key (sc_test_...) while integrating: test events are free and have no probative value; with live keys (sc_live_...) every event is permanent and costs one credit.
Derive client_ref from the source fact and retry a failed or unknown POST /v1/events with the same client_ref and the same content: you get the original event, never a duplicate.
The body of POST /v1/events depends on the channel modality (GET /v1/channel): payload or a multipart file on content channels, hash and hash_alg on hash-only channels.
Certifications are asynchronous: POST /v1/certifications answers 202; poll GET /v1/certifications/{id} or use the certification.completed webhook.
Decide on the error code and retryable, never on the message.
